published.source: Fury re-search after the off hand Rage x0.5, main hand only Windfury and Grace of Air rulings (#75, #86, #88), 2026-10-16

verify.note: same sim as the published number

summary: Dual wield Fury with a 2.8 sec sword and a 2.9 sec axe in Berserker Stance: Bloodthirst, Whirlwind and Flurry, with Death Wish and Recklessness at the pull. It is the warrior's default Level 60 preset and its highest-DPS build.
rotation: Start in Berserker Stance with no Rage; Battle Shout from the raid
Sunder Armor as the first GCD after the pull (every warrior; the tanks keep it up after)
Death Wish right after the Sunder, Recklessness one GCD later
Racial cooldowns with Death Wish (Blood Fury and Berserking also at the end of the fight); trinket on cooldown; Mighty Rage Potion at the pull, second held for the last 20 sec
Execute first in the execute phase
Heroic Strike queued from 50 Rage (outside execute)
Hamstring filler from 10 Rage (procs Windfury Totem and Flurry)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 30 Strength and 16 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown

Rage from white hits is normalised to the weapon: k × swing speed (k 3.46 one-hand, 4.5 two-hand, measured at level 30), growing with level to ×1.5 at 60 (s = 0.5), the off hand the same. An assumption until measured at 60
Synthetic Phase 1 gear on Forever's physical budget (ids 991001-991018)
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Heroic Strike VIII, raid Battle Shout VI, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air)
Deep Wounds ticks can't crit (client attribute); Deep Wounds tick timer restarting on each crit is a modelling choice
Crit Rage bonus assumed white hits only; Heroic Strike swings count for Unbridled Wrath (open assumptions)
One +2% crit elixir a character: whether Ferocity stacks with Mongoose in game is open; a second crit elixir (Grizzly) would add 15.1
Battlegear of Glory 4-piece (+36 AP vs Humanoids) not counted (would add 10.8 at 180 s)
Second Mighty Rage Potion held for the last 20 sec: +6.4 at 180 sec, -3.0 at 120 sec (the preset targets 180 sec)
Bloodthirst sometimes slips a GCD for lack of Rage; holding fillers for it loses
Raid damage hits on the warrior (2 a minute at 1500 damage, about 15 Rage each) are an estimate from boss timers, not measured in logs; the assumptions panel runs 0 and 10 a minute
notes: Request from mksettings -spec fury -gear level60_phase1_synthetic_fury -apl level60_fury -talents 30305013002-25053005122010501-2 -race Orc -duration 180, unedited (mksettings sets the raid hits, 2 a minute at 1500). Raid buffs, Kings and Might, debuffs, consumes, professions (Engineering, Alchemy) and the Level 60 encounter match ui/warrior/presets.ts.
